rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Federal minimum wage and overtime cover domestic workers since 1974; live-in workers are exempt from overtime. Several states have domestic workers' bills of rights.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: A-3 and G-5 visas need a written contract in a language the worker understands.

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Overtime pay, but live-in workers exempt.
No federal weekly rest (some states, e.g. New York, provide 24 hours).

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: Document servitude is a federal offence.
A-3 and G-5 visas tied to one employer.
Recruitment fee bans for some visas and federal contractors.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Courts and the Wage and Hour Division.

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan
rules.n: Social Security covers domestic employees above an earnings threshold.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence

rules.vi: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: National Labor Relations Act excludes domestic service.

decisions.nm: Hoffman Plastic Compounds, Inc. v. NLRB
decisions.ct: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.pe: A worker in the United States lost his job for supporting a union. Because he had no permission to work, the Supreme Court said he could not get the wages he would have earned, even though the employer broke the law.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja di Amerika Serikat dipecat karena mendukung serikat. Karena ia tidak punya izin kerja, MA menyatakan ia tidak bisa mendapat upah yang seharusnya ia peroleh, walaupun majikan melanggar hukum.

decisions.nm: Avena and Other Mexican Nationals (Mexico v. United States of America)
decisions.pe: Mexican nationals arrested in the United States were not told they could call their consulate. The World Court said the US broke international law and must review their cases. Many were never reviewed.
decisions.pi: Warga Meksiko yang ditangkap di Amerika Serikat tidak diberi tahu bahwa mereka boleh menghubungi konsulat. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan AS melanggar hukum internasional dan wajib meninjau ulang perkara mereka. Banyak perkara tidak pernah ditinjau.

decisions.nm: Case No. 2227 (United States): remedies for undocumented workers after Hoffman Plastic
decisions.ct: ILO Committee on Freedom of Association
decisions.pe: After the US Supreme Court denied back pay to an undocumented worker fired for organising, unions complained to the ILO. The ILO committee said the remaining remedies were not enough.
decisions.pi: Setelah MA AS menolak upah tertunggak bagi pekerja tanpa dokumen yang dipecat karena berserikat, serikat pekerja mengadu ke ILO. Komite ILO menyatakan sisa pemulihan tidak memadai.

decisions.nm: Undocumented Workers v. United States (Report No. 50/16)
decisions.pe: Undocumented workers injured at work or not paid in the US took their case to the Inter-American Commission. It said the US must give them the same labour protection as others.
decisions.pi: Pekerja tanpa dokumen yang cedera atau tidak dibayar di AS membawa perkaranya ke Komisi Inter-Amerika. Komisi menyatakan AS wajib memberi mereka perlindungan kerja yang sama.

decisions.ct: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.pe: Texas let schools charge or exclude children without immigration papers. The Supreme Court said this broke the constitutional guarantee of equal protection.
decisions.pi: Texas membolehkan sekolah memungut biaya atau menolak anak tanpa dokumen imigrasi. MA menyatakan ini melanggar jaminan konstitusional atas perlindungan yang sama.

decisions.ct: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.pe: Arizona and Pennsylvania denied welfare to non-citizen residents. The Supreme Court said treating lawful residents worse because they are not citizens needs strong justification, which was missing.
decisions.pi: Arizona dan Pennsylvania menolak tunjangan sosial bagi penduduk bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan memperlakukan penduduk sah lebih buruk karena bukan warga negara butuh alasan kuat, yang tidak ada.

decisions.ct: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.pe: Men who could not be deported because no country would take them were held for years. The Supreme Court said detention after about six months must end unless removal is likely soon.
decisions.pi: Pria yang tidak bisa dideportasi karena tidak ada negara yang menerima ditahan bertahun-tahun. MA menyatakan penahanan setelah sekitar enam bulan harus berakhir kecuali pemulangan segera mungkin.

decisions.pe: Consular notification and the binding force of provisional measures.
decisions.pi: Pemberitahuan konsuler dan kekuatan mengikat tindakan sementara.

decisions.nm: The Haitian Centre for Human Rights et al. v. United States
decisions.pe: Interdiction of Haitian boats on the high seas and summary return of the people on board to Haiti. The Commission found that the American Declaration applied to conduct at sea and that the returns breached the rights to life, liberty and security, equality, asylum and judicial protection. Key text on extraterritorial…
decisions.pi: Pencegatan kapal warga Haiti di laut lepas dan pemulangan seketika penumpangnya ke Haiti. Komisi menyatakan bahwa Deklarasi Amerika berlaku atas tindakan di laut dan bahwa pemulangan itu melanggar hak atas hidup, kebebasan dan keamanan, persamaan, suaka, serta perlindungan hukum. Bandingkan dengan Hirsi Jamaa v.…

decisions.ct: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.pe: A Belgian Marxist scholar was refused a visa to speak in the United States. The Court upheld the refusal, holding that courts will not look behind a facially legitimate and bona fide reason given by the executive for excluding a non-citizen. Comparator on judicial deference in admission decisions.
decisions.pi: Seorang akademisi Marxis asal Belgia ditolak visanya untuk berceramah di Amerika Serikat. Mahkamah menguatkan penolakan itu: pengadilan tidak akan menguji lebih jauh alasan eksekutif yang secara lahiriah sah dan beritikad baik untuk menolak orang asing. Pembanding.

decisions.nm: Rafael Ferrer-Mazorra et al. v. United States
decisions.pe: Cuban nationals who arrived in the 1980 Mariel boatlift were held for years in immigration detention. The Commission found violations of the rights to liberty and to protection from arbitrary arrest under the American Declaration. Comparator on prolonged immigration detention.
decisions.pi: Warga Kuba yang tiba lewat eksodus perahu Mariel 1980 ditahan bertahun-tahun dalam penahanan imigrasi. Komisi menyatakan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan dan perlindungan dari penangkapan sewenang-wenang menurut Deklarasi Amerika. Pembanding.

help.nm: US Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
help.de: Free, confidential complaints about pay and conditions, including for farmworkers and H-2A workers, whatever your immigration status. Interpreters in over 20 languages.
help.di: Pengaduan gratis dan rahasia tentang upah dan kondisi kerja, termasuk bagi buruh tani dan H-2A, apa pun status imigrasi Anda. Juru bahasa dalam lebih dari 20 bahasa.

help.de: Search by zip code for free or low-cost nonprofit immigration legal services near you.
help.di: Cari berdasarkan kode pos layanan hukum imigrasi nirlaba yang gratis atau murah di dekat Anda.

help.de: Advocacy group for farmworkers. Publishes know-your-rights guides in English and Spanish, including for H-2A workers. It does not run a legal clinic.
help.di: Kelompok advokasi bagi buruh tani. Menerbitkan panduan hak dalam bahasa Inggris dan Spanyol, termasuk bagi pekerja H-2A. Tidak membuka klinik hukum.

help.de: Free, confidential help in over 200 languages for people in forced or exploitative work, including farm work. You can also text 233733. Run by Polaris, not by the police or immigration.
help.di: Bantuan gratis dan rahasia dalam lebih dari 200 bahasa bagi orang dalam kerja paksa atau eksploitatif, termasuk di pertanian. Bisa juga SMS ke 233733. Dijalankan Polaris, bukan polisi atau imigrasi.

help.city: Texas dan enam negara bagian selatan
help.de: Free legal help for migrant and seasonal farmworkers, including H-2A workers. Farmworkers in Alabama, Tennessee, Kentucky, Mississippi, Louisiana and Arkansas are served by its Southern Migrant Legal Services.
help.di: Bantuan hukum gratis bagi buruh tani migran dan musiman, termasuk pekerja H-2A. Pekerja di Alabama, Tennessee, Kentucky, Mississippi, Louisiana dan Arkansas dilayani Southern Migrant Legal Services.

help.de: Free legal services for farmworkers and low-income rural Californians: wage theft, housing and pesticide exposure. Call the office nearest your farm.
help.di: Layanan hukum gratis bagi buruh tani dan warga desa berpenghasilan rendah di California: pencurian upah, perumahan dan paparan pestisida. Hubungi kantor terdekat dari kebun Anda.
